newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY UNION - MALLETT AND REECE-EDWARDS JOIN SPRINGBOK MANAGEMENT.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION - MALLETT AND REECE-EDWARDS JOIN SPRINGBOK MANAGEMENT.

text.p: Boland coach Nick Mallett and Natal assistant coach Hugh Reece-Edwards have been appointed to the new South African rugby union management team.

Springbok manager Andre Markgraaff will continue as overall coach, but he told a news conference on Monday Mallett would help him in coaching the forwards and Reece-Edwards would be in charge of the backs.
Carel Du Plessis, the former Western Province wing, has been given the title "tactician."

A Springbok at fullback in Australia in 1993, Reece-Edwards joined the coaching staff at Natal after retiring in 1994. Mallett played alongside Markgraaff in the successful Western Province sides of the 1980s.
In the recent tests against the New Zealand All Blacks, South Africa won the final match 32-22 but lost the series 2-1.
